title: OL 9 must be configured so that the rsyslog service is active.
check_content:
Verify that OL 9 rsyslog is active with the following command:

$ systemctl is-active rsyslog 
active

If the rsyslog service is not active, this is a finding.
fixtext:
Enable the rsyslog service with the following command:

$ sudo systemctl enable --now rsyslog
VulnDiscussion: The rsyslog service must be running to provide logging services, which are essential to system administration.
